name: Sample APIs Coffee
tagline: Free mock coffee product data for demos and learning
description: SampleAPIs Coffee is a free, public mock REST API that returns coffee product data (hot and iced) as JSON. No authentication is required. It is intended for prototyping, tutorials, and frontend demos rather than production use.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public sample API; no published request quotas

example.response_snippet: [{"title":"Black Coffee","description":"Savor the simplicity of a classic black coffee...","ingredients":["Coffee"],"image":"https://images.unsplash.com/...","id":1}]

use_cases: list hot coffee drinks for a menu UI demo
fetch iced coffee items for a mock product catalog
get a single coffee drink by id for detail pages
prototype a coffee shop app without a backend
practice REST/JSON parsing with food product data
